source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 6 (a)-(d): swing h(t) = 1.5 + 1.2 sin(3 pi t); maximum, minimum, period, first time at 2.12 m. Answer key PDF 309.

blocks.prompt: 6 A child is playing on a swing in a playground. The height \(h(t)\) of the swing seat above the ground (in meters) at time \(t\) (in seconds) is modeled by the function: \(h(t) = 1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi t)\). (a) What is the maximum height reached by the swing seat?
blocks.explanation:
\(a + b\sin(\ldots)\) ki sab se bari value, jahan \(a = 1.5\) aur \(b = 1.2\).
Plan: sine zyada se zyada 1 ho sakta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(t) = 1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi t)\).
Humein find karna hai: jhoolay ki seat ki sab se zyada unchai.
Tareeqa: \(\sin(3\pi t) \le 1\) aur \(b = 1.2\) positive hai, is liye maximum \(= a + b\). 1.5 m darmiyani unchai hai aur 1.2 m amplitude, yani seat 1.5 m se 1.2 m upar tak jati hai.

Sine ki sab se bari value lein
\[\sin(3\pi t) = 1\]
\[h = 1.5 + 1.2(1) = 2.7\]
Kyun: Sine ke saath plus sign hai, is liye sine sab se bara to unchai sab se zyada.

Yeh kab hota hai
\[3\pi t = \tfrac{\pi}{2} \Rightarrow t = \tfrac{1}{6} \text{ s}\]
Kyun: Sine \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) par 1 hota hai; dono taraf \(3\pi\) se divide kiya: \(t = \frac{1}{6}\) second.

Tasdeeq
\[h\left(\tfrac{1}{6}\right) = 1.5 + 1.2\sin\tfrac{\pi}{2} = 2.7 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(t = \frac{1}{6}\) rakhne se waqai 2.7 m aata hai; yeh value sirf had nahi, seat yahan tak pohanchti hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 A child is playing on a swing in a playground. The height \(h(t)\) of the swing seat above the ground (in meters) at time \(t\) (in seconds) is modeled by the function: \(h(t) = 1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi t)\). (b) What is the minimum height reached by the swing seat?
blocks.explanation:
Isi function ki sab se chhoti value.
Plan: sine kam se kam \(-1\) hota hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(t) = 1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi t)\).
Humein find karna hai: seat ki sab se kam unchai.
Tareeqa: \(\sin(3\pi t) \ge -1\), is liye minimum \(= a - b\).

Sine ki sab se chhoti value lein
\[\sin(3\pi t) = -1\]
\[h = 1.5 + 1.2(-1) = 0.3\]
Kyun: \(1.5 - 1.2 = 0.3\). Darmiyani unchai se ek amplitude neeche.

Yeh kab hota hai
\[3\pi t = \tfrac{3\pi}{2} \Rightarrow t = \tfrac{1}{2} \text{ s}\]
Kyun: Sine \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) par \(-1\) hota hai; \(3\pi\) se divide kiya to \(t = \frac{1}{2}\) second.

Tasdeeq
\[0.3 > 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Seat zameen se 0.3 m (30 cm) upar rehti hai; asal jhoolay mein bhi seat zameen ko nahi chhooti, is liye jawab maqool hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 A child is playing on a swing in a playground. The height \(h(t)\) of the swing seat above the ground (in meters) at time \(t\) (in seconds) is modeled by the function: \(h(t) = 1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi t)\). (c) How long does it take for the swing to complete one full back-and-forth motion (period)?
blocks.explanation:
Ek poori aage-peeche harkat ek period hai.
Plan: \(\sin(ct)\) ka period \(\frac{2\pi}{c}\) hota hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(t) = 1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi t)\), yani \(c = 3\pi\).
Humein find karna hai: period, yani ek poora jhoola kitne second mein.
Tareeqa: \(\sin\theta\) har \(2\pi\) baad dohraya jata hai; \(\sin(ct)\) tab dohrayega jab \(ct\) mein \(2\pi\) ka izafa ho, yani \(t\) mein \(\frac{2\pi}{c}\) ka.

Period formula lagayein
\[\text{Period} = \dfrac{2\pi}{3\pi} = \dfrac{2}{3} \text{ s}\]
Kyun: \(\pi\) upar neeche cancel ho gaya. Yani jhoola har \(\frac{2}{3}\) second (taqreeban 0.67 s) mein ek chakkar poora karta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[h\left(t + \tfrac{2}{3}\right) = 1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi t + 2\pi)\]
\[= h(t) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(t\) mein \(\frac{2}{3}\) jama karne se angle mein bilkul \(3\pi \times \frac{2}{3} = 2\pi\) jama hota hai, aur sine wahin wapas aa jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Period \(\frac{2\pi}{3\pi}\) hai, \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) nahi; \(\pi\) ko bhool jana aam ghalti hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 A child is playing on a swing in a playground. The height \(h(t)\) of the swing seat above the ground (in meters) at time \(t\) (in seconds) is modeled by the function: \(h(t) = 1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi t)\). (d) At what time(s) does the swing seat first reach a height of 2.12 meters?
blocks.explanation:
\(h(t) = 2.12\) ko hal karna hai aur sab se chhota positive \(t\) lena hai.
Plan: sine ko akela karna, inverse sine (radians mein), phir \(3\pi\) se divide.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(t) = 1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi t)\), \(h(t) = 2.12\).
Humein find karna hai: pehla waqt \(t > 0\) jab seat 2.12 m par ho.
Tareeqa: Formula ko ulta khol kar: pehle 1.5 minus, phir 1.2 se divide, phir \(\sin^{-1}\). Jaise kapre pehnne ka ulta tarteeb se utarna.

Sine ko akela karein
\[1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi t) = 2.12\]
\[1.2\sin(3\pi t) = 0.62\]
\[\sin(3\pi t) = 0.5167\]
Kyun: Dono taraf se 1.5 minus kiya, phir dono taraf 1.2 se divide kiya: \(0.62 \div 1.2 = 0.5167\).

Inverse sine lein
\[3\pi t = \sin^{-1}(0.5167)\]
\[\approx 31.11^{\circ} = 0.5430 \text{ rad}\]
Kyun: \(\sin^{-1}\) batata hai ke kis angle ka sine 0.5167 hai. Calculator sab se chhota positive angle deta hai, jo pehle waqt ke liye chahiye. \(3\pi t\) radians mein hai, is liye degrees ko \(\frac{\pi}{180}\) se multiply kar ke radians banaya.
Dhyan dein: Degrees (31.11) ko seedha \(3\pi\) se divide karna sab se aam ghalti hai.

\(3\pi\) se divide karein
\[t = \dfrac{0.5430}{3\pi} = \dfrac{0.5430}{9.4248}\]
\[\approx 0.0576 \approx 0.058 \text{ s}\]
Kyun: \(3\pi \approx 9.4248\). Itna chhota waqt is liye ke jhoola bahut tez hai: poora chakkar sirf \(\frac{2}{3}\) second.

Pehle chakkar ka doosra waqt
\[3\pi t = \pi - 0.5430 = 2.5986\]
\[t \approx 0.276 \text{ s}\]
Kyun: Sine Quadrant II mein bhi positive hota hai, is liye seat neeche aate hue dobara 2.12 m se guzarti hai. Sawal "time(s)" kehta hai, is liye yeh bhi bata diya; phir yeh pattern har \(\frac{2}{3}\) second baad dohraya jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[1.5 + 1.2\sin(3\pi \times 0.0576)\]
\[= 1.5 + 1.2(0.5167) = 2.12 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Waqt wapas formula mein rakha to wohi 2.12 m aaya.
blocks.final_answer: Pehli dafa \(t \approx 0.058\) s (upar jate hue); dobara \(t \approx 0.276\) s (neeche aate hue)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein 0.05 second chhapa hai. Sahi value \(t = \frac{\sin^{-1}(0.5167)}{3\pi} = \frac{0.5430}{9.4248} = 0.0576\) s hai, jo round karne par 0.058 s (do decimal tak 0.06 s) banti hai, 0.05 s nahi.
